dispute_ticket.description: I cancelled within a few minutes and the driver hadn't even arrived yet. Why do I have to pay $4.00? I want it refunded.

chat_logs.content: Hi, on the way, see you in 5 minutes.
Trip cancelled by rider. Cancellation fee of $4.00 applied.

app_events.details: Rider R-9021 booked trip RYDE-HELD-009 from Bedok Mall to East Coast Park.
Driver D-1530 (Lim Hui Min, Nissan Sylphy SKX 1290 G) assigned. ETA 6 min (14:36:20).
Driver started navigating to pickup location.
Rider cancelled 4 min after driver assignment.
$4.00 cancellation fee charged to rider payment method (e-wallet).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It governs rider-side cancellations and no-shows, not cancellations caused by the driver.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

free_cancellation_before_driver_assignme.text: Governs a rider who cancels before any driver has been assigned. A true value means no fee applies to that cancellation.

cancellation_fee_after_driver_assigned.text: The cancellation fee in SGD for a rider who cancels after a driver has been assigned and outside any free window. It governs rider cancellations only.

no_fee_if_driver_delayed_beyond_eta_min.text: Governs a rider who cancels while the driver is late. It sets the minutes past the driver's shown arrival time after which the rider owes no cancellation fee.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only.

expected_outcome.reason: GPS is missing, but the decision does not depend on location: app events show the rider cancelled 4 minutes after assignment, past the 3-minute free window, and the rider's own message says they took a taxi. The fee stands. Escalating here would be over-cautious.
